name: Thandiwe Nkosi
bio:
Thandiwe's journey into motorsport began in her father's small engineering workshop outside Johannesburg, where she spent countless hours tinkering with engines and learning the intricacies of metalwork. Her passion for precision and problem-solving led her to pursue a career as a machinist, specializing in high-performance engine components. Over the years, she has developed a reputation for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to diagnose and resolve even the most challenging mechanical issues.

Joining JHR Developments was a natural progression for Thandiwe, allowing her to apply her expertise in a high-pressure, competitive environment. She is known for her demanding approach, pushing both herself and her colleagues to achieve the highest standards of quality. Her experience working on a variety of racing engines has given her a deep understanding of the materials science and engineering principles behind their construction and maintenance. Thandiwe's creative problem-solving skills and perfectionistic approach make her a valuable asset to the team, consistently striving for innovation and efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Short, tightly coiled afro, streaked with subtle grey at the temples.
physical.description: Thandiwe is a strong woman with a practical demeanor and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils perfectly before starting work.
Insists on listening to classical music while calibrating machinery.
Has a collection of vintage engineering tools she occasionally uses.
